klipler.istem: The glowing golden figure-eight line pulses softly with light, dust motes drift, very slow push-in toward the bee. The bees stay completely still, wings and legs do not move, nothing new appears, 3D animation style preserved.
Soft sun rays slowly sweep across the meadow, the grass and flowers sway gently in the breeze, light flares softly. Slow camera glide forward. 3D animation style preserved.
